theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The platform is enterprise-grade spiritual travel with a luxury premium feel. It needs to reflect the serene, awe-inspiring, and expansive nature of the Himalayas and ancient temples, blending high-end cinematic aesthetics with deeply rooted spiritual warmth.

typography.pairing_strategy: The Old Money Tech (Classic Serif Headings + Sterile Mono/Clean Sans Body) customized for spiritual luxury.

headings.description: Architectural, elegant serif that resonates with ancient temple aesthetics and luxury.
headings.usage: H1, H2, large display numbers, hero texts. Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for sizes > 32px.

subheadings.description: A humanist sans-serif with a graceful, classic feel for bridge texts.
subheadings.usage: H3, H4, overlines (with uppercase and tracking-[0.2em]).

body.description: Clean, highly legible geometric sans to handle the complex dashboard and booking data.
body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, data tables, labels.

rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, Open Sans completely.
Overlines MUST be Uppercase + Wide Spacing.

general_rules.tints: Never use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF. Dark backgrounds are tinted Himalayan Blue, Light backgrounds are tinted Parchment/Bone.
general_rules.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle gold accents (#D4AF37) for interactive states or magical AI moments.
general_rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. When placing text over hero images, use bg-black/40 overlay max, with text shadow.

spacing_and_layout.scale: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24.

marketing_pages.hero: Max overlay opacity bg-black/40. The image must breathe. Use gradient overlay instead of flat blanket.

dashboards.grid: Control Room grid. grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
dashboards.density: Use cardless UI where possible, flat backgrounds with 1px border. Deep padding to separate sections visually rather than heavy boxes.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Mobile-first. Left-align dense content. Symmetrical centering only for primary hero or high-impact editorial statements.

surface_strategies.navigation: Crystal Glass. Sticky z-50 with backdrop-blur-xl and delicate inner stroke.
surface_strategies.dashboard_widgets: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px border (border-border). Minimal border radius (rounded-md). No heavy shadows. Tactile hover lift (-translate-y-1).
surface_strategies.footers: Massive Space. py-24. High contrast shift from body content.
surface_strategies.ai_planner: The 'Tracing Beam' effect on the AI chat input or recommended package cards to signify alive technology.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis for momentum scrolling on marketing/landing pages.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use Framer Motion. Subtle staggered fades for temple lists and package grids (e.g., transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements MUST have explicit hover text and background color changes.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Spiritual/Mandala-inspired slow rotating SVG loader instead of standard spinners.

component_rules.marketing: Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS. Raw divs and sections to achieve overlapping editorial layouts.
component_rules.dashboard_and_booking: Heavily customized Shadcn UI components. Use Shadcn tables, calendars, and dialogs. Strip generic Vercel aesthetic, inject Marcellus/Manrope fonts and gold/saffron accents.
component_rules.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for marketing, Regular for dashboards).

hero_and_abstract.description: Luxurious spiritual travel conceptual art, glowing golden light over snow capped himalayan peaks. Use for main landing page hero.
Abstract minimalist mandala background, deep navy blue and metallic gold. Use for AI Planner background or VIP sections.

himalayas_landscapes.description: Snow capped mountains in distance. Use for Kailash/Nepal package banners.
Himalayas at sunset. Use for Char Dham package banners.

temples_and_culture.description: Tall Indian temple structure. Use for Temple Detail pages or Temple Explorer.
Ancient brown temple. Use for architectural historical context.
Ganga Aarti scene. Use for immersive cultural experiences and package features.

media_urls.guidance: DO NOT use placeholder URLs. Map these exact URLs to specific components dynamically.

testing_guidelines.data_testid: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST have a role-based kebab-case data-testid attribute. Example: data-testid='package-book-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Marcellus, Tenor Sans, and Manrope fonts.
Setup routing for marketing landing, temple explorer, planner, and the multi-role dashboards.
Implement light/dark mode toggling, ensuring the deep Himalayan Blue and Parchment Cream scales are preserved.
Use framer-motion for staggering lists in Temple Explorer and Package Explorer.
